title: The Brothers Speak
description: A 9-second example of talking heads (sketch/heads.js): two public-domain photographs of Wilbur and Orville Wright on a 1903 front page, each mouth moving on its own voice. Copy it into projects/<id>/, put your own photos in "heads", then head-rig, sketch-vo (free on edge), sketch-audio, sketch-render.

_sources.wilbur.jpg: Wilbur Wright, 1905. Library of Congress, public domain (commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Wilbur_Wright_1905.jpg), cropped and scaled to 900 px.
_sources.orville.jpg: Orville Wright, 1905. Library of Congress, public domain (commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Orville_Wright_1905.jpg), cropped and scaled to 900 px.
_sources.facts: The first powered flight: 17 December 1903 at Kill Devil Hills near Kitty Hawk, North Carolina; Orville flew, 12 seconds (Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum). The newspaper is invented.

lines.text: We are Wilbur and Orville Wright.
Twelve seconds. It felt a good deal longer.
